name: nextjs-i18n-demo
description: Production-grade Next.js 16 multilingual demo - six locales incl. RTL, ICU plurals, localized SEO, 45 unit + 21 E2E tests, CI, and a multilingual video pipeline.

paragraphs: An industrial multilingual showcase built with the Next.js App Router and next-intl: six languages (including a right-to-left script and four Indian scripts), ICU formatting with real CLDR plural rules, multilingual SEO, statically generated pages, and a full unit + end-to-end test matrix.

The repository doubles as a reference implementation: every architectural decision is documented in docs/, every source file carries doc comments, and the content/ directory ships the complete content-marketing kit that presents the project (blog, social posts, and a multilingual YouTube video pipeline).
features: Locale-prefixed routing — every page lives under an explicit locale segment (/en,
/hi/about, ...) with Accept-Language detection, a NEXTLOCALE preference cookie, and redirects handled in the Edge proxy.
Static generation — all locale/page combinations are pre-rendered at build time
(generateStaticParams + setRequestLocale); production requests are served from the CDN without running React.
